name: section-toggle
title: Section Toggle
description: A collapsible section with a title, description, and switch toggle that reveals content when enabled. Uses namespace exports: SectionToggle.Root, SectionToggle.Header, SectionToggle.TextGroup, SectionToggle.Title, SectionToggle.Description, SectionToggle.Content, SectionToggle.Composed (composed).

docs.lead: A toggleable section that expands to reveal content when a switch is activated.
docs.usage:
import * as SectionToggle from "@/components/ui/section-toggle"

// Composed (recommended)
<SectionToggle.Composed
  title="Title"
  description="Description"
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
>
  {children}
</SectionToggle.Composed>

// Namespace
<SectionToggle.Root open={open}>
  <SectionToggle.Header open={open}>
    <SectionToggle.TextGroup>
      <SectionToggle.Title>Title</SectionToggle.Title>
      <SectionToggle.Description>Description</SectionToggle.Description>
    </SectionToggle.TextGroup>
    <Switch.Root variant="neutral" checked={open} onCheckedChange={setOpen} />
  </SectionToggle.Header>
  <SectionToggle.Content open={open}>{children}</SectionToggle.Content>
</SectionToggle.Root>

api.name: SectionToggle.Composed
api.description: Composed version — renders the full toggle section with built-in switch from props.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the switch is toggled

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the content area

props.name: headerClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the header row

api.name: SectionToggle.Root
api.description: The outer container with subtle background, border, and rounded corners.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls the visual state — white background when closed, gray when open

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the root container

api.name: SectionToggle.Header
api.description: The header row containing the text group and the switch. The switch is the section’s only control — it owns the role, the accessible name and the keyboard path. When collapsed and onOpenChange is provided, the header also acts as a pointer-only click target that opens the section; it claims no role and takes no tab stop.

props.name: open
props.description: Current open state — when false and onOpenChange is provided, clicking anywhere in the header opens the section.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback fired when the collapsed header is clicked to expand the section. Pass the same handler to the switch inside the header so both paths stay in sync.

api.name: SectionToggle.TextGroup
api.description: Groups the title and description together, filling available space.

api.name: SectionToggle.Content
api.description: The collapsible content area with animated height transition via framer-motion.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls visibility with animated expand/collapse transition
